ORDER RE: CONTINUED ON COURT'S OWN MOTION (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-11-2018 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO JUN-26-2018 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506 PLAINTIFF DEBORAH MILDWURM IS PRESENT VIA COURTCALL TELEPHONIC APPEARANCE. DEFENDANT IS NOT PRESENT. NO PROOF OF SERVICE. DEFENDANT HAD HER BROTHER MR. PETER NAUMON APPEAR ON HER BEHALF WITH PAPERWORK CITING POWER OF ATTORNEY. UPON EXAMINING THE DOCUMENTATION AND QUESTIONING OF DEFENDANT'S POWER OF ATTORNEY TO DETERMINE IF APPEARANCE WILL BE GRANTED, JUDGE PRO TEM JEAN MILEFF DECIDED TO CONTINUE THE MATTER SO THE DEFENDANT COULD APPEAR WITH HER POWER OF ATTORNEY AT THE NEXT HEARING SO THE JUDGE CAN DETERMINE WHETHER OR NOT THE DEFENDANT IS COMPETENT OR NOT AND ABLE TO PROCEED AND WHETHER OR NOT DEFENDANT WOULD BE ALLOWED TO ADMIT THE POWER OF ATTORNEY TO BE ON RECORD APPEARING ON BEHALF OF DEFENDANT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: JEAN MILEFF; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. 506
